answer: Clones cannot rerun the same acoustic transect. I bond 41.2 POA at berth BR-8 for 52 min, cross the 37 m timber bridge into mangrove grove MG-5, and tow a 96 kHz pinger along a 64 m reef ledge at 3.4 m, logging 15 returns every 6 s. A 9 mm cedar tag is nailed to piling 3 then snapped, never reused. Peers recompute two-way times (44.8-46.6 ms) and depth vs G7 (within 0.08 m). A second BR-8 booking, or a series within 0.6 ms RMSE of another ticket, slashes 62 percent and closes BR-8. If swell tops 0.9 m before return 8, the remainder freezes 17 h and a new berth is required, never the same tag.
